recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, hazy photograph of a vintage conversion van towing a white trailer on a suburban street, featuring heavy film grain and large, semi-transparent sans-serif typography integrated into the sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Van and trailer as the central diagonal subject
Foggy sky acting as a canvas for large-scale display text
Suburban houses providing a repetitive, muted background
Film grain and dust textures unifying the foreground and background
coreInvariants: Heavy analog film texture (dust and scratches)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The van and trailer occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, angled from the center-left toward the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The front grille of the van serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the van from the bottom right up toward the large text in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The foggy, overexposed sky provides significant negative space for the primary title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grey and muted blue (van and asphalt)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted green (grass) and subtle orange (van indicators)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with high-key values in the upper half to simulate fog.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid deep blacks; use lifted shadows

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Tall, narrow, blocky letterforms with uniform stroke weight
Bottom text: Wide, lowercase, geometric letterforms with thick strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Top text uses high transparency (approx 40-60%) to blend with the sky
Bottom text is opaque white with tight kerning
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between vertical condensed and horizontal geometric forms.

preserve: Lowercase geometric nature of bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, condensed, bold display style for the top text.
Provides the geometric, wide, lowercase look for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A desaturated photograph of a 1980s conversion van with a white box trailer parked on a suburban street. The lighting is hazy and foggy, washing out the sky. Apply a heavy film grain and dust texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, semi-transparent white condensed sans-serif text in the sky area. Add bold, lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the bottom left corner over the grass.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible across the entire image?
Is the color palette desaturated and muted?

adjustableVariables: Transparency level of the top text
Specific model of the vintage van
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the van
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the main van body
Check that the film grain doesn't look like digital noise
Verify the bottom text is legible against the grass
Confirm the sky is sufficiently bright to host the transparent text
recipe.reuseFormula: Suburban scene + Foggy atmosphere + Film grain + (Condensed Display Text at 50% opacity) + (Geometric Bold Lowercase Text at 100% opacity)
